name: smwblocks-remove-carryable-items
title: Remove Carryable Items
description:
This block removes any carryable item, including those stored in yoshi's mouth.

A couple notes:
-Sprites that can be stunned won't be removed untill they are (koopas, walking bob-ombs, galoombas, etc.)

-Items stuck on yoshi's tongue won't be removed (they probably disable object interaction, idk)

Credit is optional.
